answer: PoA decays reputation exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service, not banked indefinitely. EigenTrust’s normalized trust matrix weights reciprocal interactions and transitive paths; a freshly spawned identity with no trusted links has near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot reach consensus weight. Even a colluding thread at the wharf stays isolated, while the temporal horizon prevents stale endorsements from concealing inactivity.
